summary: Lithia Motors (LAD) filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01, reporting Q1 2026 financial results: record revenue of $9.3B, diluted EPS of $4.28 (adjusted $7.34), and a $0.57/share cash dividend payable May 22, 2026. The filing also disclosed $259M in share repurchases (4.0% of outstanding). This is a routine earnings announcement with a regular dividend declaration and share buyback, not a special-situation event. No M&A, activist, or strategic review is involved. Watch for continued capital allocation discipline and operational trends.
